test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 04 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Eight teachers Anil, Kamal, Ram, Sanjay, Aakash, Vivek, Rahul and Ramu are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Ramu is third to the left of Ram. Vivek is third to the right of Ram. Aakash is to the immediate right of Anil. Sanjay is not the immediate neighbour of Ram or Ramu. Rahul is second to the left of Anil. Who is second to the left of Kamal?
solution:
Given: Eight teachers Anil, Kamal, Ram, Sanjay, Aakash, Vivek, Rahul and Ram.

1) Ramu is third to the left of Ram.

2) Vivek is third to the right of Ram.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/248be91eea2c6177bb8baaa55172b7a93dcd5398dcf9b8b9771218a425ce6f38.png] 

3) Sanjay is not the immediate neighbour of Ram or Ramu.

4) Aakash is to the immediate right of Anil.

5) Rahul is second to the left of Anil.

And, Kamal will sit on the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3e6bd815e2051c169b2067069a8437db5d0ed39b837844aba8b06782593eefd.png] 

Here, 'Aakash' is second to the left of Kamal.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
